two_stage_decoupled_hunting_architecture.mandate: MANDATORY DECOUPLING: Never combine identity discovery with asset synthesis in a single step.

stage_1_identity_and_contact_ground_trut.focus: Deterministic identity verification from live Google Places/Maps & active web pages only.
fields_collected: Exact Business Name (from Google My Business)
Exact Website URL (or flagged as Dead/Offline/None)
Verified mailto: Email Address (if absent, strictly set to null/empty; NEVER guess/hallucinate)
stage_1_identity_and_contact_ground_trut.gate_1_review: User inspects and verifies contact numbers and Google Maps links before Stage 2.

stage_2_reputation_assets_and_prototype_.focus: Deep audit and custom asset generation on approved ground-truth leads only.
fields_collected: Verified Star Rating & Exact Review Count
Original Brand Logo extraction & Color Palette derivation
Technical Website Audit / Mobile conversion blockers
10-Section Bespoke Prototype deployment with image linter guard
Tailored DIC Outreach Copy + 1-Click WhatsApp Direct link
stage_2_reputation_assets_and_prototype_.gate_2_review: User inspects live bespoke prototypes and copy before safe drip sending.

zero_hallucination_contact_guard.rule: Every phone number, mobile number, and email must be verified against live Google Places / GMB or live web pages. Placeholders such as 'recipient@target.com' or guessed local area code numbers are strictly illegal. If no email exists, outreach defaults exclusively to verified WhatsApp/Phone.

Style B: Dual-Tier Enterprise Navigation Bar (Top utility contact ribbon + Sticky navbar)
Style C: Minimalist Asymmetric Monogram Bar (Large brand crest + 1-Click WhatsApp)

Style E: Ultra-Clean Ghost Minimalist Header (Borderless translucent navigation)

image_verification_and_linter_guard.rule: Every image must strictly match the verified clinical/specialist category (operatory, veneers, clear aligners, microscope surgery, verified patient portraits). Any unverified or spa/bathroom photo triggers a fatal build error.

continuous_self_evolution_protocol.rule: All new user design feedback, preferences, and architectural upgrades automatically append to this ledger and sync to GitHub without altering baseline safety protocols. The system compounds knowledge over time across every run.
continuous_self_evolution_protocol.cumulative_compounding_directive: MANDATORY: Never wipe, overwrite, or discard historical system rules, design architectures, image linter standards, or flow protocols. Always build additively on top of existing knowledge, treating previous iterations as foundational baseline rules that must be preserved, refined, and complimented.

local_engine_70_pct.advantages: 90%+ WhatsApp open/read rates within 15 mins, zero friction, 24-48h close cycle, instant portfolio proof.

international_engine_30_pct.advantages: High-ticket USD invoices, automated scheduled sending, long-term scalability.
